content:
Decisions under the owner's standing delegation, answering the parked session's three questions plus T-013's two. Owner may veto any of these; until then they are the contract.

1. ISS-075 / sourceVersion semantics: ADOPT WATERMARK SEMANTICS. sourceVersion is redefined as a verified input watermark DERIVED FROM CCUSAGE OUTPUT, not a consumed-offset claim: per source, the newest event time the computation reflects (monotone under append-only cost data, robust to retention pruning deleting OLD transcripts). Dominance keeps its shape — every live source present, at least one strictly newer, missing source fails closed — because the gate's protective purpose (a dropped source or an older-than-live computation must never replace the live snapshot) is fully served by the watermark. What it deliberately stops claiming: that ccusage read every byte it could have. v0.1 already ships ccusage's word verbatim; auditing ccusage's internals was never this store's burden, and pretending otherwise is how four designs died. REQUIRED ADDITION: equality (no new activity anywhere) must become an explicit no-op outcome distinct from refusal — a fresh run that found nothing new is not a regression. T-010's contracts, comments and tests change accordingly; the consumed-offset ideal moves to the v0.5 owned-parsing ticket where it becomes witnessable.

2. ccusageFetchedAt: RENAME to ccusageInvokedAt, keep required. Record the fact we can prove (when we ran ccusage) under a name that says so. No optionality needed for an always-known instant.

3. Native-error boundary: the rule was always "native errors are inspected only at an adapter"; fs was simply the only adapter that existed. ADD A NETWORK ADAPTER owning EADDRINUSE/EACCES classification exactly as the fs adapter owns fs errnos. The constraint generalizes; it does not bend.

4. ISS-079 / T-013 reader lease: CUT THE LEASE ENTIRELY. Readers never compute. No live service means an immediate honest-stale answer carrying freshness metadata plus an actionable service-not-running signal; cold computation belongs to the service alone. This satisfies bounded wait trivially, keeps readers-never-write intact, and deletes the machinery whose four properties could not coexist. T-013 AC 6 is rewritten to this; the 60-80s measured pipeline cost makes any in-band top-up a fiction for MCP clients that time out at 60s.

5. T-013 readGeneration(id): APPROVED as an addition to T-010's public read surface, limited to pinned or manifest-retained generations, with the same envelope+invariant validation as readSnapshot (note ISS-064: generation-body invariants must exist first). Pins already exist to retain generations for cursors; this is the missing reader half of that mechanism.

Sequencing: re-plan T-011 against 1-3 (the parked plan docs/t011-headless-service-plan.md is the base, not a restart), then T-013 against 4-5, then T-012 unblocks behind T-011.
title: N-007: decisions unblocking T-011/T-013 (ISS-075, ccusageFetchedAt, error boundary, ISS-079, readGeneration)
